referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The direct Wm. Farmer & Sons website in Hudson, New York uses night-time storefront photo with a large simple identity mark. Navigation is narrow dark utility strip and direct boarding or barroom routes. Its page moves through storefront opening, barroom scene, boarding scene, event room scene, quiet testimonial, contact footer, with separate full-width routes for dining, rooms and events. dim real interiors kept legible with restrained dark overlays. Transferable mechanics are three full-bleed choices, gold outline actions, dark room photography. The brand identity, people, photographs, reviews, wording and business claims remain source-only.
